<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">TileGeoBoundsCalculator</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>A calculator of geodetic bounds for tiles identified by keys generated
 in a particular tiling scheme (<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-tilingscheme" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview.datasource"><code>TilingScheme</code></a>).
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behavior. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
</li>
</ul>
